2014_spells.touch-of-the-void-egw.descri: You touch a creature with void energy. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 cold damage and have its speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
2014_spells.touch-of-the-void-egw.effect: Deal 1d8 cold damage to a target within Touch
